def: An optional extra stake (often about 25% more per spin) that raises the chance of triggering free spins. It increases the cost of every spin.
Thunderkick's and NetEnt's name for tumbling reels: winning symbols disappear and new ones fall into place.
Normal paid spins, outside any bonus feature.
Paying a fixed multiple of your stake to go straight into a bonus round. Banned in some markets, including Great Britain.
How often the main bonus triggers on average, e.g. 1 in 180 spins.
A slot where a special symbol expands to cover whole reels during free spins, popularised by Book of Dead.
Another name for tumbling reels – winning symbols are removed and replaced from above.
A pay system where groups of matching symbols touching horizontally or vertically form wins.
A symbol that gathers the values of cash or coin symbols on the grid, common in fishing and hold-and-win games.
Playing a slot with play-money credits instead of real money. Official demos run the same rules as the real game.
Hacksaw Gaming's expanding wild reels where two characters duel and the winner's multiplier applies to the reel.
A wild that grows to cover a whole reel, often with a multiplier or respin.
Any special event beyond a normal win: free spins, respins, modifiers or pick games.
A bonus round of spins at no cost, usually triggered by three or more scatter symbols.
An optional double-or-nothing step after a win. You can lose the win entirely.
How often any winning spin lands, e.g. 1 in 4 spins. Includes wins smaller than your stake.
A respin feature where coin symbols lock in place and new ones reset a respin counter.
The share of each stake a game keeps over the long run: 100% minus the RTP.
A wild or xWays symbol that spreads its symbol to other positions on the grid.
A set prize, usually a multiple of your bet, awarded by special symbols or a full grid.
The largest payout a slot allows from one spin or bonus round, as a multiple of your stake.
Big Time Gaming's mechanic where reel heights change every spin, giving up to 117,649 ways to win.
A value that multiplies a win – on a wild, a grid position, a reel or the whole round.
A symbol that reveals a random symbol, wild or feature after the reels stop. All mystery symbols usually reveal the same thing.
Fixed lines across the reels on which matching symbols must land to win.
Also called scatter pays: enough matching symbols anywhere on the grid win, with no lines or adjacency needed.
A multiplier that grows with each win or cascade during a feature, often without resetting.
A free re-spin of some or all reels, usually with certain symbols held in place.
Extra free spins awarded for landing more scatters during the bonus round.
Return to player: the percentage of all money wagered that a slot is designed to pay back over millions of spins.
One of several RTP configurations of the same game that providers offer casinos, e.g. 96.5%, 95.5% and 94.5%.
A symbol that pays or triggers a feature wherever it lands, regardless of lines.
A wild that stays in place for more than one spin.
Hacksaw Gaming's tumble variant that removes every symbol of a winning type, not just the winning group.
Winning symbols disappear and new ones drop in, so one paid spin can win several times.
How unevenly a slot pays: high volatility means rarer but bigger wins, low volatility means frequent smaller wins.
A wild that moves one position (usually one reel left) on each spin, paying again where it lands.
A pay system where matching symbols on adjacent reels pay in any row, e.g. 243 or 4,096 ways.
A symbol that substitutes for other symbols to help complete wins.
Nolimit City's option to pay a higher stake per spin for a better chance of triggering bonuses.
Nolimit City's exploding wild that clears neighbouring symbols and raises the win multiplier.
Nolimit City's stacked wild that nudges into view, adding +1 to its multiplier with each step.
Nolimit City's mechanic that splits symbols in half to double them, often doubling a multiplier too.
Nolimit City's mystery symbol that reveals several copies of one symbol, making the reel taller and adding ways.
